rv.q: Blink allows us to sit in the knowledge that both these things can be true.
Both unsettling and unexpectedly tender, this beautifully crafted two-hander pulls the audience into its strange, delicate world and keeps us hooked from start to finish.
Excellent writing and production of a play which, at its heart, is about love, or is it?

cn.t: Critics find this unsettling yet tender two-hander a darkly reimagined tale of voyeurism and connection, with Porter's play exploring parasocial obsession through beautifully crafted performances that hook audiences despite its disquieting premise.
